quickref.name: Toxic Terror
quickref.era: BBG only. Added in BBG 2.3, Sep 27, 2013 (iOS date per the wiki). Official fly-through preview published Sep 13, 2013 by BATTLE BEARS. Beta name 'X Marks the Pain' (fan copy of the beta notes, Aug 2013, plus wiki page history; unverified). No rework recorded. Still playable in the ~2022 64-bit build.
quickref.in_2026: Not named in the Steam store text. The official 2026 OST has track 14 'Toxic Terror' (1:18) [Canon]. Its tile is one of 16 map stills in SkyVu's official short 'BBG Maps Ranked part 1' [Observed]. That makes it likely in the '16 wacky maps' roster [Inference], but this is not confirmed. It does not appear in the Steam trailer or screenshots.
quickref.setting: A radioactive sewer under a city street at night. Two-floor ('double-floored') cavernous sewer with green waste, and a big climbable tree growing up through the middle. Comic sewer-lair dressing: tally marks, a ninja-turtle weapon rack and chalk bear drawings.
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Dark green-grey brick and concrete (#1A251D, #222A1E, #161815; ceiling #101B0E). Neon lime ooze and grate glow (#4BFE82, #53FC23, #13FE01; mint highlight #4BFFA7). Caged amber lamps (#FFD030, #FFDB66). Red accents and light (#952E1B, #840000; copper pipe #6B331C). Blue-violet rim light. Tree bark #4B361D/#251B13. Underground at night with low ambient light and green bounce everywhere. Concept art (not final) is slate-blue (#314557) with warmer light.
quickref.landmarks: 1) The central climbable twisted tree. 2) The heart carving on its bark ('O' and '+' legible). 3) The bent drain pipe pouring ooze into a glowing grated pool beside a poster pillar, DANGER sign and amber lamp (the official preview shot). 4) The Blue-base wall of chalk tally marks beside a rack of blue-hilted swords and a purple staff. 5) Glowing green floor grates and ooze channels. 6) A manhole shaft opening to the night sky.
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No jump pads. Climbable tree. Pickups: Bearscream Sandwich and Imperial Basket Grande either side of the tree, 2 Health Packs on the upper spawn floors 'behind a brown lump', and 2 Shields behind barriers near the tree. You can spawn on a Health Pack. In PTB the bombs sit inside the spawns and the tubes by the tree. Whether the ooze does damage is unverified. Easter eggs: the O+A heart (fans read it as Oliver+Astoria; not canon); tally marks (the 2013 wiki said '22 days'); TMNT weapons; a wiki-claimed 'drawing of Botch' that no image confirms. Concept-only gags: a poopman, a ninja-masked bunny doll, a skeleton, 'THE END IS NE…' graffiti.
